node.title: THE DIAMOND INSIDE FRAMEWORK
node.reading:
A JubAp / IMSV.org rationalization method · Developed through a three-year, 50+ Maison programme

Most rationalization programmes begin by listing systems and ranking them for cost. In a uniform organization that can work. In a decentralized, heritage-rich group it quietly destroys value, because the things that make such a group valuable — local excellence, cultural identity, hard-won adaptations — rarely show up on a portfolio list as anything other than «duplicates.»

This is the trap the Cost of Clarity work names precisely: the information you would need to rationalize safely is treated as free, when in fact it is costly and often missing. Declaring a clean target architecture and cutting toward it is not a safe cleanup — it is a blind bet against value you cannot see. Diamond Inside is the operational answer to that bet: pay the cost of clarity up front, understand why each capability exists, and only then decide.

Read the capability, its dependencies and tacit support before classifying an option. The luxury rationalization case supplies the field setting described by the method. Anything proposed for wider use then needs its own admission decision: local usefulness is evidence to examine, not automatic readiness to scale.

The programme stops asking «what can we remove?» and starts asking «what value is already inside the group that we cannot yet see — and which of it is worth scaling?»

relations: Diamond Inside opportunities can be described more precisely by separating technical contribution, current recognition and the route through which value might actually be realized.
El protocolo de atribución no es una tasación financiera ni demuestra que el valor potencial se haya realizado.
Diamond Inside's value-discovery proposition can be examined through the revaluation-before-clarification hypothesis without treating a potential opportunity as realized financial value.
No todos los activos ocultos son diamantes, y una contribución detectada puede ser sustituible, costosa o legítimamente prescindible.
The survivor lens sharpens value discovery: identify the useful capability and its carriers before deciding which legacy form should remain, change or disappear.
Encontrar valor en un legado no legitima conservar todo su coste, riesgo o estructura de atribución.
Diamond Inside offers a possible selection lens for stewardship: preserve the useful capability while deciding separately whether its original implementation should remain local, change or retire.
Traslado propuesto entre dominios. La clasificación de valor no concede derecho a archivar, abrir o retirar un activo ajeno.
Evidence that a useful capability exists may justify a bounded search, while discovery, ownership, scale-up permission and realized value remain separate questions.
Traslado propuesto de un modelo de decisión; no convertir sospecha o posibilidad en certificado de existencia.
Knowing enough to classify a capability and establishing a positive net gain are independent tasks; both should be qualified before a scale-up decision.
La implementación de PR60 no determina el ROI de una empresa ni sustituye la validación de las fuentes o de la métrica.
